Step.name: Set Variable
Step.StepText: Set Variable [ $sessionDay; Value:Let ( ~p = Substitute ( SessionNote::sessionDate ; "-" ; ¶ ) ; Date ( GetValue ( ~p ; 2 ) ; GetValue ( ~p ; 3 ) ; GetValue ( ~p ; 1 ) ) ) ]

Value.Calculation: Let ( ~p = Substitute ( SessionNote::sessionDate ; "-" ; ¶ ) ; Date ( GetValue ( ~p ; 2 ) ; GetValue ( ~p ; 3 ) ; GetValue ( ~p ; 1 ) ) )

Step.name: Set Variable
Step.StepText: Set Variable [ $weekStart; Value:Let ( ~t = Get ( CurrentDate ) ; ~t - DayOfWeek ( ~t ) + 1 ) ]
Step.Name: $weekStart

Step.name: Set Variable
Step.StepText: Set Variable [ $weekPrefix; Value:Let ( [ ~s = $weekStart ; ~e = $weekStart + 6 ] ; Year ( ~s ) & Right ( "0" & Month ( ~s ) ; 2 ) & Right ( "0" & Day ( ~s ) ; 2 ) & "-" & Year ( ~e ) & Right ( "0" & Month ( ~e ) ; 2 ) & Right ( "0" & Day ( ~e ) ; 2 ) ) ]

Step.Name: $weekPrefix

Step.name: # (comment)
Step.StepText: #1) List the Allegheny folder. Normalise Windows line breaks so GetValue sees one entry per line.
Step.Text: 1) List the Allegheny folder. Normalise Windows line breaks so GetValue sees one entry per line.

Step.name: Set Variable
Step.StepText: Set Variable [ $folderList; Value:Substitute ( BE_FileListFolder ( $printBase ; 2 ) ; [ Char ( 13 ) & Char ( 10 ) ; ¶ ] ; [ Char ( 10 ) ; ¶ ] ) ]
Step.Name: $folderList

Step.name: # (comment)
Step.StepText: #2) Match by the date prefix. Entries may come back as bare names or full paths - keep only the last path segment.
Step.Text: 2) Match by the date prefix. Entries may come back as bare names or full paths - keep only the last path segment.

Step.name: Set Variable
Step.StepText: Set Variable [ $weekFolder; Value:While ( [ ~l = $folderList ; ~n = ValueCount ( ~l ) ; ~i = 0 ; ~r = "" ] ; ~i < ~n and IsEmpty ( ~r ) ; [ ~i = ~i + 1 ; ~v = Trim ( GetValue ( ~l ; ~i ) ) ; ~v = If ( Right ( ~v ; 1 ) = Char ( 92 ) ; Left ( ~v ; Length ( ~v ) - 1 ) ; ~v ) ; ~v = If ( PatternCount ( ~v ; Char ( 92 ) ) ; Right ( ~v ; Length ( ~v ) - Position ( ~v ; Char ( 92 ) ; Length ( ~v ) ; -1 ) ) ; ~v ) ; ~r = If ( Left ( ~v ; Length ( $weekPrefix ) ) = $weekPrefix ; ~v ; "" ) ] ; ~r ) ]

Value.Calculation: While ( [ ~l = $folderList ; ~n = ValueCount ( ~l ) ; ~i = 0 ; ~r = "" ] ; ~i < ~n and IsEmpty ( ~r ) ; [ ~i = ~i + 1 ; ~v = Trim ( GetValue ( ~l ; ~i ) ) ; ~v = If ( Right ( ~v ; 1 ) = Char ( 92 ) ; Left ( ~v ; Length ( ~v ) - 1 ) ; ~v ) ; ~v = If ( PatternCount ( ~v ; Char ( 92 ) ) ; Right ( ~v ; Length ( ~v ) - Position ( ~v ; Char ( 92 ) ; Length ( ~v ) ; -1 ) ) ; ~v ) ; ~r = If ( Left ( ~v ; Length ( $weekPrefix ) ) = $weekPrefix ; ~v ; "" ) ] ; ~r )
